info.title: Fenergo Nebula Screening Query
info.description:
**Screening Query API**:
Screening Query API retrieves screening results for screened clients and their associated parties. Use Screening Command API to perform the screening action and Screening Query API to retrieve screening results.
**Screening Query API Provides**:
  • The ability to retrieve screening results for all entities within a given batch of Legal Entities. batchID + tenant can be used to retrieve screening results of all entities within a given batch.
  • The ability to retrieve batch data for a batch of Legal Entities. BatchID + tenant **OR** journeyID + tenant can be used to retrieve results for a batch of screened Legal Entities.
  • The ability to retrieve screening results for a single entity within a given batch of Legal Entities. EntityID + batchID + tenant can be used to retrieve screening results for a given entity.
  • The ability to retrieve screening results for all matches of a given entity. EntityID + batchID + tenant can be used to retrieve screening results that match the given entity.
  • The ability to retrieve screening results for matches of a given match ID. EntityID + batchID + matchID + tenant can be used to retrieve screening results that match the given match ID.

get.summary: Get all documents for a given entity across all batches, optionally scoped to a specific journey
get.description:
Returns all documents associated with the specified entity across all batches, with status `Closed` or `Overridden`. When a journeyId is provided, results are scoped to that journey. Without it, all batches for the entity are searched. Only documents in `Completed` status are included; documents from batches that are deleted or that are not `Closed` or `Overridden` are also excluded. Document statuses reflect the last-known value from the read model and are not enriched in real-time from DocManagement.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: ScreeningAccess

parameters.description: The Id of the entity

parameters.name: journeyId

parameters.name: X-TENANT-ID
parameters.description: The UiD of the tenant representing organization

post.summary: Get a list of all screening entities found corresponding to a list of legal entity IDs.
post.description:
This method returns a list of all screening entity objects found corresponding to a given list of legal entity IDs. Pre-requisites: For a screening entity to be returned for a given legal entity id, it must already exist in the Screening domain. If no screening entity is found for a given legal entity id, it will simply not be included in the response. The response will contain only the screening entities found. A maximum number of 100 legal entity IDs can be submitted in a single request. To query for more, please split them into multiple requests.

Required permissions:
Following permissions are required: ScreeningAccess
